title: Dire Dryer
overview: Lynn N. is a five-year-old girl who can't sleep without her blanket. She is afraid of the dark and the loud rumbling of the dryer; only her blanket can make her feel safe enough to sleep. When Lynn has to sneak out after bedtime, she discovers the dryer has created laundry monsters that lurk in the shadows and must confront her fears to rescue her blanket.
